welcome.title: Welcome to the control room 👋
welcome.body:
You run the meeting from this tab; your notes stay here, for you only.

  • Open the shared screen: a tab made for projection, without menus.
  • Share that tab in the video call, not your whole screen: it is what the team sees.
  • Come back here to drive: everything shows live on the shared screen.
Navigate with → and ←, quit with Esc.

runOrder.title: The agenda and the speaking order
runOrder.body:
Intro, one turn per person, open topics, then the wrap-up.

  • ↑ ↓ change the order, Absent takes someone out of the round.
  • Go jumps straight to a step.
  • A green dot: that person's check-in is ready.

controls.title: Start and move on
controls.body:
• Start the meeting plays the intro on the shared screen.
  • Next (→) gives the floor to the next person; the timer shows their speaking time left.
  • Space pauses the timer, +30 s gives a little extra time, End the meeting jumps to the wrap-up.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.body:
One notes area per step, saved as you type and seen only by you: they go into the minutes, under the right person.

+ Decision records a decision; + Action creates a follow-up action with an owner, tracked in the next sessions.

minutes.title: The minutes
minutes.body:
They write themselves from the check-ins, your notes, the decisions and the actions.

At the end, Archive the meeting: the minutes go to the history and the next session is ready.

finish.title: Your turn!
finish.body: People, schedule and modules are set in the meeting's settings. This button replays the tour whenever you like. Have a great meeting!
